purpose: Clarify the computational realization of the frozen spatial-plus-hierarchical model so sparse taxa are not forced to estimate eight spatial nuisance coefficients independently.
reason_for_clarification: The source-cohort reporting floor is 10 observations per taxon. Fitting eight spherical-basis coefficients separately inside every taxon would consume most or all residual degrees of freedom and would not be a faithful implementation of the intended common broad-scale spatial control.

within_taxon_spatial_realization.method: Frisch-Waugh-Lovell residualization with common nuisance effects
steps: For each response coordinate, residualize the observation-level response against taxon intercepts plus the common second-order spherical basis.
For each frozen environmental predictor in the hypothesis-specific conditional model, residualize that predictor against the same taxon intercepts plus the same common spherical basis.
Within each taxon, regress the residualized response on the residualized hypothesis-specific environmental predictors without another intercept.
Retain the slope vector and its sampling covariance when the within-taxon environmental design has full column rank and at least three residual degrees of freedom.
within_taxon_spatial_realization.additional_estimability_rule: n_taxon >= number_of_environment_predictors + 3, full predictor rank, >=4 quarter-degree support cells, and each predictor being interpreted must vary within taxon
within_taxon_spatial_realization.effect_of_nonestimability: The taxon remains in source/measurement coverage summaries but does not contribute an unstable taxon-specific slope to that formulation's random-effects hyperdistribution. This is an algebraic estimability rule, not an outcome-dependent exclusion.

partial_pooling_realization.per_slope_coordinate: normal-normal random-effects meta-analysis using taxon slope estimates and their sampling variances
partial_pooling_realization.between_taxon_variance: estimate tau^2 by REML with tau^2 constrained >=0
partial_pooling_realization.shrinkage: report empirical-Bayes posterior means and variances under the fitted normal-normal model
partial_pooling_realization.taxon_weight_interpretation: weights are statistical precision from observation-level slope uncertainty, not raw photograph counts or biological abundance weights

among_taxon_spatial_realization.method: include the same eight second-order spherical terms evaluated at the equal-observation taxon coordinate centroid directly in the weighted among-taxon meta-regression

residual_spatial_check.interpretation: Residual spatial autocorrelation is reported as model limitation/diagnostic and does not trigger significance-based model switching.
